ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given points $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ are on the same line, where point $C$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$, and point $D$ is on segment $AB$. If $AB=6$ and $BD=\frac{1}{3}BC$, what is the length of segment $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that point C is the midpoint of segment AB, and $AB=6$,\\
$\therefore$ $BC=\frac{1}{2}AB=3$,\\
$\therefore$ $BD=\frac{1}{3}BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $BD=\frac{1}{3}\times 3=1$,\\
$\therefore$ $CD=BC-BD=3-1=\boxed{2}$.
